wedge: supplier/manufacturer SDS PDF + Amazon listing details + Amazon Dangerous Goods acceptance rules => Amazon-specific existing-SDS submission QA for chemical-based products before inventory commitment or resubmission; not SDS authoring or full hazmat approval
last_material_result: Fresh Amazon Seller Forums evidence strengthens the timing/value wedge without changing the live test. Amazon staff explicitly says sellers can submit an SDS for Dangerous Goods review before creating inventory/shipping once an ASIN exists, with review typically within 2 business days, specifically to avoid manufacturing/inventory cost on a document that will not pass. A recent rejection case shows concrete preventable defects: missing manufacturer/brand information, fragrance variants not covered separately, and missing pH/flash-point values. A separate Jan-Feb 2026 seller case shows the opposite boundary: an unchanged manufacturer SDS was alternately reopened/restricted over Section 2/3 vs Section 14 interpretation, confirming that Amazon/manual classification can remain nondeterministic and must never be guaranteed by the checker. Preserve the live $15 existing-SDS QA test unchanged until Day-3.
economics: Free 1-SDS -> $15 existing-SDS preflight paid intent; contribution/WTP unproven. Value can accrue before inventory commitment by catching deterministic document/listing defects, but specialist authoring/approval starts around $40 and generated SDS drafts can be $15, so preflight must remain narrow and cannot promise Amazon approval.
